answer: At an in-person ceremony, venues issue one credential per attendee during the same short window worldwide. A verifier gives a fresh task, such as moving a walnut past a mirror and turning a prism on command. Honest staff prevent repeat enrollment at one venue, while simultaneous distant sessions stop one person touring many sites. A farm must hire more people and pay their travel. Corrupt hosts and paid attendees remain weaknesses; liveness is not proof of honest intent.
